texts.label: Jan Chodkiewicz, Szkłów, to Maximilian II, 22 Feb 1575
texts.summary: Jan Chodkiewicz writes to Emperor Maximilian II during the Polish-Lithuanian interregnum: he doubts the emperor's plan would bring confusion and splits, proposes sending his servant Adam Theim to win the Lithuanian electorate and then Polish nobles for the Habsburg candidacy, and advises a contract first with the higher nobility only (Kopal and Waldispühl's summary). The full German plaintext is in Kopal and Waldispühl, HistoCrypt 2023 (their letter E), and on the DECODE record.
